item.title: Israeli Forces Capture A Hamas Ally In South Lebanon As An Israeli Drone Kills 3, Including A Child
item.description: BEIRUT (AP) — Israelis forces seized a local official with a Sunni Islamist group and an ally of the Palestinian militant Hamas group in an operation in southern Lebanon early on Monday, and took him to Israel for questioning, the Israeli military and Lebanese state media reported. Also on Monday, an Israeli drone struck a car in the southern Lebanese village of Yanouh, killing three people, including a 3-year-old child, Lebanon’s state-run National News Agency said, quoting the Health Ministry.

item.title: Feds Address Raid
item.description: The feds are responding to reports that ICE agents raided a San Antonio home without a warrant. A video of the encounter has gone viral, showing people in the home fighting back. A spokesperson says they were hunting for Mejia Ortega, who had previously been deported and had three prior arrests for domestic assault. They say he fled into the home but disappeared. And, they say, agents had a warrant.

item.title: Passenger Rail Funding
item.description: There has been talk for years about funding passenger rail in Texas as a way to cut down on traffic jams. State Representative Terry Canales says the problem can no longer be ignored. He told a rail conference in the Rio Grande Valley that “we cannot pave our way out of population growth.” The latest census numbers show that around one-thousand people are moving to Texas every day.
